player_prompt.intro:
Uyeyipleya {player_id} kwi Connect Four.
Isimbo sekati yakho: {symbol}.
Bhoja dwe game ina {num_rows} imihla nemigangatho {num_cols}.
Iipleya zithatha izicuko zokuthintisa disk yazo kwi koloni (0 ukuya kwi {end_col}).
Uyaphakama kwanokwenzeka ukuthinta (iziko zakhe) ziphathe zine zithinte phezulu, phezulu, noma phezulu-phezulu kwenza aphume.
Kwicuko lakho, ngena inombolo yekoloni kwi bracket zesikrini ukwenza icuko lakho.
Njengesemelo: '[col 4]' noma '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Fomati ye ingxenye engalungi. Ifomati elilungu: '[col x]'.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} wathintisa disk yayo ({player_symbol}) kwi koloni {col}.
